name: blueprint/delegate-cli-coder
description: Delegate a bounded coding task to a CLI coder: rh_run (or rh_run_bg for long runs) invokes it with one written brief, receipts record the run, and the pre-commit-gate reviews the diff before it ships.
use_cases: a feature to a CLI coder
ingredients: rh_run / rh_run_bg for the CLI invocation
guard ask on the invoke step
recipe: write the brief (bounded task, one outcome) -> guard-gate the invoke -> rh_run the CLI coder with the brief -> receipt: exit code + tail -> review: run the pre-commit-gate chain on the diff -> red: loop with a follow-up brief; green: merge receipt
result_kind: brief + run receipt + gate receipts per task
cost_hint: the CLI coder's own cost; everything else local
pitfalls: the brief is the contract - one outcome per task
long runs belong to rh_run_bg (status only - poll, do not wait)
the gate reviews the DIFF, not the run output
guard ask on invoke keeps delegation a decision, not a reflex
